partial: quantization of activations to int8 may increase secondary actor through cost improvement (read as compute efficiency improvements).
quantization of activations to int8 may increase performance available through cost improvement (read as efficiency improvements).

H5.finding: The choice of model, datacenter and processor can reduce the carbon footprint of training by up to ~100-1000x.

H6.finding: Under data constraints, repeating data up to ~4 epochs is nearly as good as unique data, after which extra compute loses value.

H7.finding: Deep learning progress is strongly reliant on growing compute, which makes it economically and environmentally unsustainable along current lines.
full: Gains in capabilities from progress in AI development may be offset by compute used to train a model.
high training compute generally indicates and progress in AI development may jointly drive model capabilities, and their effects may compound.

H8.finding: AI accelerator chips (and staff) are the largest expenses in training frontier models. The growth rate of training cost is context, not part of this finding.

H9.finding: Training on model-generated content causes irreversible model collapse.
